One retrospective single-centre series (n=14; ages 11–82) reported oral LT4 loading 300–500 micrograms followed by taper over 3–5 days, but this small uncontrolled series is insufficient to make that a general adult emergency regimen. Completed focused ESVS 2025/WSES 2022 review in v1.29. Clarified acute MVT first-line therapeutic UFH/LMWH and nonoperative vs peritonitis/deterioration escalation; UFH reversibility in acute phase; 3–6 month VKA/LMWH duration, conditional DOAC alternative and indefinite treatment for idiopathic/persistent risk; separated arterial AMI and NOMI from MVT. Local weight-based UFH/LMWH protocols, monitoring and case-specific peri-procedural decisions remain pending. No new module ID added.
